rows._was: en was 'canoeing'. canottaggio is rowing; canoeing is canoa or canoismo. This one matters beyond itself: 007 dropped the invented headword 'rematura = rowing' on the grounds that canottaggio already covered rowing, which was only true of the word, not of the gloss. With this fix the file has rowing again.
en was 'fishmonger', which now collided with pescivendolo after 006 corrected that entry to the person. pescheria is the shop.
en was 'to foresee', which is prevedere --- already in the file, glossed exactly that way. preporre is to put something or someone ahead of another.
en was 'to lighten'. lampeggiare is what lightning or an indicator does.
en was 'motorway', which is autostrada and already in the file. A strada statale is the non-motorway state road network.
en was 'handcrafted', an adjective. artigianato is the noun; artigianale is the adjective and is already present.
en led with 'grimace', which is smorfia. A grinza is a crease in cloth or skin.
